title: Assert the exact text each branch shows, not a pattern every branch matches
rule: When a component chooses between wordings by data ('all 3', '2 of 3', 'unknown'), test each branch with the exact expected text (toBe / toHaveText with a string), driven by a stubbed answer for that branch. A loose regex that accepts every wording passes when the branches are swapped or when have and total are swapped, so it proves nothing.
rationale: E42.5 (#456): the 'in N of M styles' text and the axis-end alternates had no test that failed when the wording or the values were wrong.
